svg.title: Ari — quiet ivory low-top, left shoe
svg.desc: Original unitless artist design. Six independent left-shoe schematics and an entry/lacing detail. These are not registered projections, a physical pattern or foot-fit evidence.
svg.text: Original left-shoe artist design · plain toe, unstriped sidewall, five lace pairs

g.text: Five pairs; crossing layers over tongue
Left shoe: medial edge at viewer-right.
Five near-side eyelets shown; far row concealed. Low unstriped sidewall.
Independent inner view; near row shown, far row concealed. No vent holes.
Plain rounded forefoot; no toe cap.
Collar entry · counter overlay · central back join
Original surface marks; no grip claim.
Opened section, not a measured foot cavity.
Tongue below laces; quarter edges bound the opening. Right inset shows central pairs only.
Full top view owns all five pairs. Solid marks show visible design lines; section breaks are labelled.
Right counterpart: mirrored stylistic roles intended; no right shoe or anatomical pair is drawn.

svg.text: Artist schematics, independently authored views. Physical pattern, lining continuity, manufacturing, materials and foot/body fit remain open.
